app.name: Cloudflare Workers and Pages
app.description: The **Cloudflare GitHub App** automatically deploys your code to Cloudflare when you merge a pull request to your GitHub repository. It can also create a new repository on your GitHub account when you get started with a Cloudflare template. This integration also: - Displays the status of your deployments as check runs - Posts links to preview URLs as comments on each pull request (Cloudflare Pages only) For more information, refer to the [Cloudflare Workers docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/ci-cd/builds/) and [Cloudflare Pages docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/git-integration/).

console.note: The existing script-src policy blocked the optional external Cloudflare analytics beacon on two navigations. These warnings do not affect the tested first-party pages or search; no production-certification claim is made.

browser_observation.network_scope: Six final-home static requests only; the separate byte observer verifies 37 internal resources and the search result verifies the exercised live search path.

claim_boundaries: Selected-channel v1.0.0 publication remains technical-preview support only.
The release tag is lightweight and unsigned.
The immutable embedded README in the published package artifacts retains v0.7-era release wording.
No runtime performance result, universal platform support, or Windows native Python parity is claimed.
